6 years ago - I launched a self-hosted source code hosting software called "Sorcia".

https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=22685914

I am trying to revive the project back. I wanted a federated Git hosting service done with ActivityPub protocol tightly integrated to Mastodon.

I thought somebody would do it and I couldn't find such program thus far. 

I think my wait is over. I'll see what I can do here.

As always I'm starting to tackle the design first. Weirdly for me, this approach will give me a clear idea on what features are necessary whilst doing it.

(1/n)
